d: India U19 stormed into the ACC Men’s U19 Asia Cup semi-finals with a commanding 70-run victory over UAE U19. Aaryavir Sehwag starred with a sensational 160, supported by VK Vineeth’s 67, as India posted an imposing 309/7. In reply, UAE managed 239 despite Ahmed Khudadad’s fighting 73, with Ishan Sood leading India’s bowling attack with an impressive four-wicket haul.
